Test Case 7: Service Exposure Validation

Input: kubectl get svc -n metabob

Expected Output:
- At least 4 services deployed
- At least 1 service with type NodePort (for local access)
- Services include:
  - config
  - redis (redis-master)
  - metabob-rpc-api
  - metabob-dashboard

Validation:
- Verifies services are created and exposed
- Confirms NodePort services are accessible on localhost
- Tests service discovery (redis URI should resolve)
- Validates service type configuration (NodePort for local, ClusterIP for others)

Note: NodePort services allow access via http://localhost:<nodePort>
